name: Firework Launcher
label: Quest
description: Firework Launcher: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Although rockets are a wonderful way to celebrate, in order to see their glory... They must be fired from a launcher.
Bring me coins of ancestry and I can offer you the knowledge to create rocket launchers like the ones you see in Moonglade.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here you are, friend. Here is the schematic to create a firework launcher. Place launchers where you wish to celebrate, and then welcome your friends to join you!
